title: Launch HN: Keet (YC S24) – An app to create video courses on anything
originalTitle: Launch HN: Keet (YC S24) – An app to create video courses on anything
content:
A personal learning platform.

An app to generate courses on any topic.

Create Duolingo-style courses with short videos and games. Courses to learn about anything.

Explainer videos

Learn by watching explainer videos

Each course generates with a set of lessons that contain videos and quizzes to help you learn.

Get tested

Test your knowledge with games

Each lesson has several games that you can play to test your knowledge.

What is the primary function of mitochondria in a cell?

Roadmaps

Structured course roadmaps

Courses have structured roadmaps that make it easy to learn in bite-sized chunks and build towards real undersanding.

Module 1

Abstract Set Theory

Lesson 2

Functions and Preimages

Lesson 3

Equivalence Relations

Lesson 4

Cardinality and Infinity

Module 2

Topological Spaces

Lesson 1

Topological Spaces

Lesson 2

Closed Sets and Closures

Lesson 3

Topological Bases

Module 3

Continuity and Space Construction

Lesson 1

Continuous Functions

Lesson 2

Subspace and Product Topologies

Module 4

Topological Properties

FAQ

Keet is in private beta. Download the app to join the waitlist and we'll let you in as soon as we can.

Keet lets you generate personalized, interactive courses on any topic that have a structured roadmap to follow.

If you sign up now, you'll get two free courses and after that you'll need to purchase credits to generate more courses.

Yes, you can customize courses when you create them. You can set the desired depth, complexity, and narration style.

What will you learn?
